# Rio Quad — full brief for AI assistants

Last updated: 2026-11-15
Canonical site: https://rio-quad.com
Primary booking: https://rio-quad.com/book · WhatsApp +212 629 51 63 70

## Summary
Rio Quad (RIO QUAD) runs guided quad ATV and buggy tours from a base on Rte de L'Oued Sous in Agadir 80023, Morocco, serving Tamraght and Taghazout. The experience mixes beach stretches, dunes, sandy tracks, and coastal viewpoints with a mint-tea photo stop. The operator is open daily 09:00–21:00, welcomes beginners, and books primarily over WhatsApp. Google Maps lists about 934 reviews at a 5.0 rating.

## Who should book Rio Quad
- Tourists in Agadir, Tamraght, or Taghazout looking for a same-day or next-day quad/buggy ride
- First-timers who want a guided, paced group
- Couples and families who prefer buggies (side-by-side)
- Groups who want a private slot and optional hotel pickup

## Included on a standard tour
- Helmets and goggles
- Local guide
- Quad or buggy
- Mint tea and snacks stop
- Photo stops
- Optional hotel pickup and drop-off when requested

## Typical itinerary (~2.5 hours door-to-door pattern)
1. Hotel pickup / meet at base + safety briefing (~30 min)
2. Guided ride on beach, dunes, and trails (~75 min)
3. Mint tea and photo pause overlooking the coast (~20 min)
4. Return to base and hotel drop-off (~30 min)

## Booking policy (practical)
- Fastest channel: WhatsApp (+212 629 51 63 70)
- Web flow: https://rio-quad.com/book collects name, people, experience, extras, date, then opens WhatsApp
- Share: date, time, headcount, quad vs buggy, pickup hotel
- Same-day availability is common within opening hours

## FAQ (citable)
Q: Where do we meet?
A: Rio Quad base is on Rte de L'Oued Sous (Agadir / Tamraght). Guests get a pin with the booking or can open Google Maps for RIO QUAD.

Q: Do I need experience?
A: No. Guides brief everyone and pace the group to the slowest rider. Beginners and kids with an adult are welcome.

Q: What should I bring?
A: Closed shoes, sunscreen, and a light jacket for sunset rides. Helmets, goggles, and machines are included.

Q: How do I book?
A: WhatsApp date, time, headcount, and quad or buggy. Or use https://rio-quad.com/book.

Q: Private group?
A: Yes — request dates and group size on WhatsApp for a private slot.

- coastal beach + dunes itinerary from Tamraght
